SOURCE OBLIGATIONS
==================

For every distributed component whose licence carries a source obligation:
what is owed, what triggered it, and the fact that sbomb neither produces
nor can produce the material. A build-time-only component is not in this
list, because a component the product does not contain triggered nothing.

This is a list of obligations, not a compliance verdict. Whether an
obligation was discharged is not something sbomb can observe.

COMPONENTS OWING SOURCE MATERIAL

- lgpl-lib - LGPL-2.1-only - static-archive-member
  A source offer for the library, including any modification to it, is
  required.
  Static linkage additionally implicates the relinking provision of the LGPL
  (section 6 of LGPL-2.0 and LGPL-2.1, section 4 of LGPL-3.0): the material
  needed to relink the application against a modified library is part of
  what is owed.
  sbomb does not and cannot produce this material.

UNCLASSIFIED LICENCES

An identifier on neither obligation list is reported here and never assumed
permissive, so that a gap in the list is visible rather than silent. The
list is small and curated on purpose: two thousand imported classifications
nobody has read do not belong in a document that carries the manufacturer's
name.

None: every licence identifier of every distributed component is on one of
the lists.
